q1_isClause1AloneEnoughToReachTheHost.answer: Yes for REACHING the host, provided the recovery-ran flag moves into the same globalThis slot as the registry. Only primitives cross (rewind-commit.ts:232-236) and the host found is the socket graph's object, so rebuild runs the socket graph's modules: its SQLite singleton (initialized at server.js:463-464, same DATABASE_PATH per server.js:455-462) reads the branch the API graph committed; its store is the globalThis-shared match store (getDefaultMatchStore.ts:31-41); the combat journal mode resolves from the constant and env in both graphs (combatJournalAuthorityEnabled.ts:41-58). The other module-local singleton on the path is `_recoveryRan` (MatchHostRegistry.ts:221): left module-local, the API graph's first GET /api/multiplayer/matches/:id (src/pages/api/multiplayer/matches/[id].ts:72) would re-run recoverActiveMatches on the SHARED registry, constructing throwaway hosts that write (tryFoldActivatedRewindBranch supersedes the store tail, MatchRecovery.ts:192; resumePendingEventPublications, MatchRecovery.ts:213) and overwriting blocked/quarantine state. Clause (1) therefore anchors {registry, recoveryRan} together.

The owner string is `rewind-commit:${process.pid}` (rewindCommitDeps.ts:167).

q2_howTheHostSendsAndWhatAConnectedViewe.howItSends: Live events: broadcastEvent per attached socket through the publication boundary (ServerMatchHost.ts:1260-1300; broadcaster fan-out :1260-1261). One socket: safeSend (:1370-1371). A join: handleSessionJoin -> sendReplay (ReplayStart, ReplayChunk with deliverySequences, ReplayEnd, then LobbyUpdated) (ServerMatchHostReplay.ts:74-128, :282-352). Attached sockets: lifecycle.attachedSockets() (ServerMatchSocketLifecycle.ts:105-112). A rebuild sends nothing (ServerMatchHostRewindRebuild.ts:169-220).
q2_howTheHostSendsAndWhatAConnectedViewe.smallestExistingFrameSet: The join replay from 0 pushed to each attached socket, the same call handleDeliveryAck already makes (ServerMatchHost.ts:1337-1346). MEASURED below (probe M2): it reaches the connected client and changes nothing on the mirror.
q2_howTheHostSendsAndWhatAConnectedViewe.whyItIsNotEnough: The client cannot drop a fact it already applied: after discardAll the replay re-uses delivery numbers 0..k with the same event identities, which admitByDelivery drops as duplicates (client.ts:892-913); the hook mirror is append-only (useMultiplayerSession.helpers.ts:251-260) and first-occurrence-wins by sequence (mirrorMatchSession.ts:72-83), and it is reset only when the hook effect re-runs (useMultiplayerSession.ts:235-277). The next live event after the rewind then reuses a delivery number with a new identity and blocks the client (probe M4).
q2_howTheHostSendsAndWhatAConnectedViewe.whatAConnectedViewerNeeds: A signal that its applied stream is superseded, carried with the rebuilt replay, that makes the client clear its delivery admission state (client.ts IClientState applied maps, lastAppliedDelivery, delivery cursor and pins, blockedBySequenceCollision) and makes the hook clear its mirror log before the rebuilt replay is applied. No such frame or field exists in src/types/multiplayer/Protocol.ts (ReplayStartSchema :642-663 has no such field) and no client handler does this.

q3_privacyOfSendingToEveryConnectedViewe.answer: Respected if the push reuses the join path per attached socket: each socket resolves its own viewer (ServerMatchHostReplay.ts:311-316), the replay is fog-filtered per player/spectator (:425-469) and guarded by MATCH_WIRE_PUBLICATION_BOUNDARY.guardReplayFrames for that viewer (:95-105); player projections drop sequence and privateRecordRef (ViewerFrameProjector.ts:66-70, :196-209). The GM-private reason never enters the match event stream: the commit is called with REWIND_COMMIT_REASON (rewind-commit.ts:208; rewindCommitDeps.ts:45) and body.reason goes only to GmPrivatePreviewRecordWriter (rewind-commit.ts:213-227). A broadcast of one frame to every socket (ServerMatchHost.ts:1260-1261) would skip the per-viewer projection and must not be used.
